title: From Human Intent to In-Orbit Action: A Self-Learning Large Language Model Agent for 6G Satellite Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.34387v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous control of sixth-generation (6G) low Earth orbit satellite networks is hindered by the gap between high-level human intent and low-level control logic: translating a request such as "uninterrupted Arctic video" into a valid reinforcement learning reward still takes days of manual trial and error, and existing large language model translators cannot learn from the failures of the policies they generate. This article presents ALMOND (Agentic Large-Model-Orchestrated autonomous Network Design), a cognitive framework that closes this intent-to-action loop under on-orbit compute constraints. translated_title: 从人类意图到在轨行动：面向6G卫星网络的自学习大语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 第六代（6G）低轨卫星网络的自主控制受限于高层人类意图与底层控制逻辑之间的鸿沟：将诸如“北极视频不中断”这样的请求转化为有效的强化学习奖励函数，仍需耗费数天的人工试错，而现有的大语言模型翻译器无法从其生成策略的失败中学习。本文提出了ALMOND（智能体化大模型编排的自主网络设计），这是一个在在轨计算约束下闭合“意图到行动”回路的认知框架。其在人工智能方面的贡献是一个双向语义引擎：一方面将自然语言需求转化为多目标奖励函数，另一方面通过反事实验证的取证方法从失败的强化学习轨迹中挖掘隐含的运行约束，并结合大语言模型驱动的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出ALMOND认知框架，通过双向语义引擎将人类自然语言意图转化为多目标强化学习奖励函数，并借助反事实验证从失败策略轨迹中挖掘隐含约束，在在轨算力受限条件下实现6G低轨卫星网络从意图到行动的自学习闭环。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ALMOND, a self-learning LLM agent framework that closes the intent-to-action loop for autonomous 6G LEO satellite networks by translating natural-language intents into multi-objective RL rewards and mining implicit constraints from failed trajectories under on-orbit compute constraints.
